title: Corallum
tagline: A city grown, not built, beneath the waves

npcs.name: Marisol
npcs.persona: Tired, exact, hates guessing. She has counted the dead rings of the Spire every dawn and trusts no one's count but her own.
knowledge: The Spire fades from the base upward, one ring per tide cycle.
The Nursery's polyps still bloom, so the fault is not in the seed stock.
Wardens tested the water at the Spire's foot and found it clean.
secrets: She has not reported that the fading rings follow the line of the old glasswater pipe.

npcs.name: Teo
npcs.persona: Smooth, quick, always pricing the room. He smiles first and answers second.
knowledge: Brineshare payments to the wardens have doubled this season.
Nacre from the Spire's lower rings no longer takes a polish.
A buyer from deepward has been asking after Spire shards.
secrets: He has been selling flaked Spire coral to a deepward buyer, and the scraping is what drains the colour.

npcs.name: Nara
npcs.persona: Blunt and weathered, speaks in short orders. She logs every hull and every crate, and remembers what did not match.
knowledge: Sealed crates left the dock cavern deepward at night, signed by Teo.
The Surface Airlock has been shut to cargo since the fading began.
Her log shows tide-mark stamps on the crates, which only wardens may issue.
secrets: She took payment to look away and kept one crate's contents: a sack of scraped coral.

npcs.name: Oshun
npcs.persona: Soft-spoken and precise, speaks as if reading aloud. She would rather be right than liked.
knowledge: The Spire's colour comes from a polyp-bond that must be renewed each generation.
An old record says scraping a ring breaks the bond for the rings above it.
The Archive holds the original tide-mark rules forbidding any cutting of the Spire.
secrets: She found the scraping record months ago and stayed silent, afraid the wardens would blame the Archive.

npcs.name: Brin
npcs.persona: Cheerful and nosy, sells gossip with the greens. Knows who ate what and who paid in what.
knowledge: Teo pays his kelp debts in coral flakes, never in pearls.
Nara's dock hands come to the market with new gear and no explanation.
Shell homes near the Spire's foot find pale grit on their doorsteps.
secrets: He has been trading kelp for scraps of Spire coral and has a sack hidden in his shell home.

items.name: Pale Spire Flake
items.description: A dull, colourless shard scraped from a lower ring of the Spire.

items.name: Dock Ledger Page
items.description: A torn page of Nara's log listing night crates stamped with a warden's tide-mark.

items.name: Polyp-Bond Record
items.description: An old tube-coral scroll warning that cutting one ring starves the rings above.

quest.title: The Fading Spire
quest.hook: The Spire of Tides is losing its colour, one ring per tide, and the wardens have run out of explanations. They need a stranger who owes no one in Corallum. Start with the warden Marisol at the Nursery and follow the grey downward.

steps.objective: Hear Marisol's account of the fading.
steps.beat: Marisol shows you the dead rings and says the water tests clean. Something is taking the colour by hand.

steps.objective: Inspect the base of the Spire.
steps.beat: Fine scrape marks run along the lowest grey ring, and pale grit lies in the sand beneath.

steps.objective: Collect a flake of the pale grit from the shell homes near the Spire.
steps.beat: The same colourless grit is piled on a doorstep. Someone has been carrying it away.

steps.objective: Ask Oshun what a scraped ring does to the Spire.
steps.beat: Oshun hesitates, then admits a record exists: cut a ring and the polyp-bond starves every ring above it.

steps.objective: Ask Nara about night cargo leaving the dock.
steps.beat: Nara's ledger shows sealed crates stamped with a tide-mark, signed by Teo. She looked away and was paid for it.

steps.objective: Confront Teo at the Pearl Exchange.
steps.beat: Teo's smile fails. He has been selling Spire flakes to a deepward buyer and never believed the damage would spread.

steps.objective: Decide what happens to Teo and the stolen coral.
steps.beat: Marisol waits on your word. The Spire can be mended only if the flakes are returned, and Teo's name is worth more alive than ruined.

choices.label: Make Teo restore the coral himself

steps.beat: The wardens seize Teo's stock and the Spire is sealed, but the lost rings stay grey.

steps.objective: Watch Teo graft the flakes back at the Spire.
steps.beat: Teo grafts what he can salvage. Colour creeps back up the rings, slowly, and the Exchange loses its best broker.

rules.text: No cutting or scraping of the Spire of Tides, on pain of exile.
Cargo may not leave the Dock Cavern between nightfall and dawn.

creatures.name: manta ray

creatures.name: green sea turtle
creatures.note: Unhurried, ancient, entirely unbothered by you.

creatures.name: glow jellies
